alt: 孩子雙手忙著扶住自己快倒下的空紙箱，神情焦急；旁邊同學也需要幫忙，他卻只能歉意地望過去，抽不出手。
scene_prompt: 自顧不暇 means one can barely manage one's own troubles and has no spare capacity to help others. Contemporary school cleanup room. One child in foreground struggles to keep their own precarious stack of oversized empty cardboard boxes from tipping, both arms fully occupied stabilizing the boxes and knees slightly bent, anxious overwhelmed expression. Another classmate a short safe distance away has dropped a few light empty boxes and asks for help with an outstretched palm, but the first child can only glance apologetically because their own stack is already tilting and slipping. Show the first child's personal problem visibly unresolved, not ignoring others selfishly. Only two children, no heavy weights or injury risk, lightweight cardboard boxes clearly empty. Exactly two arms per child, hands naturally gripping box edges, boxes supported by arms and ground as plausible, no floating objects or impossible stacks. School storage shelves in background unlabelled. NO text, writing, numbers or speech bubbles; delicate graphite watercolor paper texture.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist.
